components.label: entry
responsibilities: Answer one command: observe the repository, then decide what the answer is.
forbidden_responsibilities: Holding a rule threshold or a comparison policy of its own.

requires.rationale: An entry point asks what an observation means; the judgement itself is decided elsewhere so a second entry cannot answer differently.
Reading the repository, its Git objects and its Python profile is shared machinery, and an entry point that reimplemented it would drift from the others.

components.label: policy
responsibilities: Turn two observations into a verdict: what was expected, what changed, what may not get worse.
forbidden_responsibilities: Reading the repository or deciding which command the user ran.

requires.rationale: A verdict is measured against recorded state, so policy reads snapshots and the runtime profile and never gathers them itself.

components.label: foundation
responsibilities: Reach the outside world - files, Git objects, the analyzer port, the runtime - and record what it says.
forbidden_responsibilities: Judging what it read, or knowing which command asked for it.

rules.rationale: Inside a component the same principle holds as above it: an import nobody asked for is an accident, so each part names what it needs and absence refuses the rest.
